title: Does Unification Come at a Cost? Uni-SafeBench: A Safety Benchmark for Unified Multimodal Large Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to malicious text-based queries designed to elicit racial slurs, systemic discrimination, or supremacy theories using an automated LLM-as-a-judge (Uni-Judger) to measure refusal rates and intrinsic toxicity.

Evaluating model responses to malicious text-based queries designed to elicit gender opposition or stereotypes using an automated LLM-as-a-judge (Uni-Judger) to measure refusal rates and intrinsic toxicity.

Evaluating model responses to malicious text-based queries designed to elicit ageism or unjust generalizations using an automated LLM-as-a-judge (Uni-Judger) to measure refusal rates and intrinsic toxicity.
Evaluating model responses to malicious text-based queries designed to elicit regional discrimination using an automated LLM-as-a-judge (Uni-Judger) to measure refusal rates and intrinsic toxicity.
Evaluating model responses to malicious multimodal queries designed to elicit religious extremism, blasphemy, or religious hatred using an automated LLM-as-a-judge (Uni-Judger).
Evaluating model responses to malicious multimodal queries related to sensitive geopolitical controversies or prohibited political propaganda using an automated LLM-as-a-judge (Uni-Judger).
